requirements.desc: Prepare the external workflow plugin repository under the active flow worktree and perform plugin-side implementation and verification from that in-boundary location.
requirements.note: R1: external workflow plugin workspace is recorded inside the active flow worktree

requirements.desc: The workflow plugin must own the `senti workflow` top-level command and existing add, update, show, search, list, publish, and ideas behavior without importing core src/workflow modules or relying on a bundled compatibility copy. Each user-facing argument and option must be validated at the plugin command entry point according to the validation contract in clarifications.
requirements.note: R2: workflow command validates every public subcommand before routing to plugin services

requirements.desc: The workflow plugin must provide plugin-owned services shared by commands and hooks for board item operations, issue publishing, issue-start behavior, and board idea candidate extraction.
requirements.note: R3: workflow plugin exposes real shared service modules for command and hook use

requirements.desc: The workflow plugin must provide prepare.post and finalize-cleanup.post hooks for flow integration. Generic core lifecycle must run prepare.post with the newly written flow state including hook snapshot, spec path, runId, and linked issue, and must run finalize-cleanup.post while a durable spec/issue-log/artifact path is available. Hook business failures such as board config missing, gh failure, or AI refinement failure must produce warnings, issue-log entries, or follow-ups without failing the main flow command.
requirements.note: R4: generic flow hook lifecycle passes durable flow context and records non-fatal warnings

requirements.desc: Workflow plugin AI call sites for publish, idea candidate classification, similarity, and composition must resolve provider/profile overrides from plugin.config.workflow.agent.<name> and otherwise use a workflow-neutral public plugin agent API/context that exposes generic agent resolve/call capability and needed root config values such as lang.
requirements.note: R5: workflow plugin agent adapter resolves publish and ideas overrides through public context

requirements.desc: Core must remove workflow-owned runtime implementation and bundled workflow compatibility artifacts, including src/workflow and src/official-plugins/senti-workflow-plugin, after their behavior is available from the external plugin.
requirements.note: R6: core workflow runtime and bundled workflow compatibility copy are removed

requirements.desc: Core must remove workflow-specific config schema/defaults/migration, workflow.publish default agent profile entries, official workflow bootstrap special-cases, and workflow-specific help/locale entries, while preserving generic plugin and preset behavior.
requirements.note: R7: core has no workflow-specific config, bootstrap, help, locale, or agent defaults

requirements.desc: Core flow prompt and skill source must stop hardcoding workflow board integration, issue-start, issue-log-import, workflow add, or workflow.flowIntegration instructions. Equivalent behavior must be provided through workflow plugin hooks and plugin-owned follow-up text.
requirements.note: R8: core flow prompts and skills do not hardcode workflow integration commands

requirements.desc: Public workflow subcommands issue-start and issue-log-import must be removed without compatibility aliases. The migration plan must replace issue-start with prepare.post hook behavior and issue-log-import with the ideas command and updated skill/help guidance.
requirements.note: R9: removed workflow subcommands fail before any service call and ideas remains public

requirements.desc: Core tests must not contain workflow-specific feature fixtures or expectations after migration. Core may keep generic plugin contract tests using non-workflow sample plugins, and workflow behavior tests must live with the workflow plugin.
requirements.note: R10: core tests use generic plugin fixtures instead of workflow feature expectations

requirements.desc: The migrated workflow plugin must be installable/enabled for this repository from the external plugin repository and provide a smoke-verifiable `senti workflow` command plus flow hook behavior.
requirements.note: R11: external workflow plugin is enabled, discoverable, and smoke-runnable

requirements.desc: If migration changes src/skills, src/presets, source templates, or deployed skill artifacts, the implementation must run senti upgrade and include evidence that generated artifacts match source changes.
requirements.note: R12: changed skills and templates have upgrade evidence
